question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it be default-on or opt-in?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and belongs within the plugin if accepted, but it changes retrieval semantics, config surface, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback behavior for an official memory option.

options.title: Implement Plugin-Local Hybrid Search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, hybrid config/default policy, vector fallback behavior, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep Advanced LanceDB Retrieval External
options.body: Leave the official plugin vector-only and direct hybrid/reranker variants to ClawHub or separately maintained packages.

options.title: Document Vector-Only Scope
options.body: Close this direction after correcting README/docs to state that memory-lancedb intentionally remains vector-only.

recommendation.title: Implement Plugin-Local Hybrid Search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned FTS indexing, hybrid config/default policy, vector fallback behavior, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory plugin history, memory-core refactors, and prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
